alloy.preparation: Base CF stock cast cylindrically and remelted in Balzers induction furnace, adjusted with high-purity Fe/Cr/Ni/Mo/graphite and N-bearing ferrochrome. Solution treated at 1120 °C for 1 h and water quenched. Standard polarization preparation: polish through 9 µm diamond paste, prepassivate in 50% nitric acid at 50 °C, paint sample edges with corrosion-resistant enamel; immediately before testing remove passive film from exposed face with diamond-paste cotton swab while preserving film beneath enamel. Mounted in epoxy with brass-screw electrical contact.
alloy.microstructure: Duplex ferrite/austenite, essentially carbide-free after solution treatment. Reported magne-gage ferrite number 7 is not a measured volume percentage.

test_solution.preparation: Nitrogen-purge deaerated aqueous test solution; purge duration not stated. Authors describe bulk pH as near 0.5.

test_method.procedure_description: Cyclic polarization starts at stable active OCP (about 3 min wait), scans anodically through critical passivation and passive range to Epit, then to 10^-4 A/cm² before reversal; reverse scan stops where current equals forward-scan current (Erp). Potentials reported versus SHE. Standard 3 V/h scan. Figure 3 means represent at least three determinations, bars total scatter.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit is the dramatic/sharp current-density increase from the passive region, distinguished from gradual crevice current, low-potential excursions, reversal limit and Erp. Reversal at 10^-4 A/cm² permits stable pitting and microscopic examination; this reversal threshold is not itself the Epit criterion.

experiments.result_note: Mean of at least three determinations; endpoints are total scatter, not standard deviation. Potential origin is experimental even though the horizontal composition index was estimated. Bulk Table 1 analyses retain percent notation; its unit basis is not explicitly printed. Estimated austenite Cr_eff index and AAS dissolution-product/film compositions are not substituted for bulk analysis. pH is reported near 0.5, not calculated. Prepassivation acid and 1120 °C treatment are distinct from the test electrolyte and 27 °C temperature.

test_method.procedure_description: Cyclic polarization starts at stable active OCP (about 3 min wait), scans anodically through critical passivation and passive range to Epit, then to 10^-4 A/cm² before reversal; reverse scan stops where current equals forward-scan current (Erp). Potentials reported versus SHE. Standard 3 V/h scan. Table 2 Epit accompanies separate AAS potentiostatic dissolution analyses; the near-active-peak and +250 mV holds characterize solution products, not the pitting-potential measurement.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Epit is the dramatic/sharp current-density increase from the passive region, distinguished from gradual crevice current, low-potential excursions, reversal limit and Erp. Reversal at 10^-4 A/cm² permits stable pitting and microscopic examination; this reversal threshold is not itself the Epit criterion.

experiments.result_note: Epit column accompanying AAS results; mV/SHE scale is shared with the paper’s experimental-potential reporting. Possible repeat of obs_001 standard-procedure summary; table does not explicitly identify the same determinations, so retained separately. Some plotted/table values differ. Bulk Table 1 analyses retain percent notation; its unit basis is not explicitly printed. Estimated austenite Cr_eff index and AAS dissolution-product/film compositions are not substituted for bulk analysis. pH is reported near 0.5, not calculated. Prepassivation acid and 1120 °C treatment are distinct from the test electrolyte and 27 °C temperature.

alloy.preparation: Base CF stock cast cylindrically and remelted in Balzers induction furnace, adjusted with high-purity Fe/Cr/Ni/Mo/graphite and N-bearing ferrochrome. Standard polarization preparation: polish through 9 µm diamond paste, prepassivate in 50% nitric acid at 50 °C, paint sample edges with corrosion-resistant enamel; immediately before testing remove passive film from exposed face with diamond-paste cotton swab while preserving film beneath enamel. Mounted in epoxy with brass-screw electrical contact.
